lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 004: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-004 fixed a false sourcing claim at docs/positioning.md section 4 (naming decision): the sentence said 'the two ADRs hold ... the kill evidence for every candidate considered', but that is false for the discarded four-round-battery candidates (Slipway, Ingot, Crivo, Assay, and the tenet/tenant/nova/fide riffs), whose kill evidence lived only in positioning.md sections 4.2/4.3 before US-002 of this PRD deleted those sections (git show 198e6bff has the deleted text if ever needed) and does not survive in ADR-0049 or ADR-0050 (verified via git grep, both files read in full this session). Chose the 'narrow the sentence' resolution path over 'carry the evidence into ADR-0050': rewriting an already-accepted ADR to retroactively add kill-evidence detail it never itself verified is riskier and out of scope for a docs-narrowing fix, and ADR-0050's own doctrine treats prior ADRs as historical record not to be rewritten. The corrected sentence now scopes the ADRs' held evidence to the finalists that actually reached a live-measured round (GAMBREL + the -board family in ADR-0049; the 2026-07-27 21-candidate round in ADR-0050) and explicitly states the wider four-round battery's kill evidence is not carried in either ADR. No other content in positioning.md, the ADRs, or CAM-0415.json was touched. Single-line diff; all quality gates (typecheck, bun test 5665 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all) green.
